advisor_identified: Historian of Russian and East European history at Queen's University (2004–2023), subsequently at the University of Florida; co-advisor of the 2015 Queen's thesis After October.

doctorate.title: Rival Visions of the Russian Nation: The Teaching of Russian History, 1890-1917

evidence.says: Her CV lists employment in the History Department at Queen's University, 2004–2023 (p. 1); identifies her dissertation as Rival Visions of the Russian Nation: The Teaching of Russian History, 1890-1917 (Harvard, 1997) (p. 4); and lists a PhD in History from Harvard University, 1997 (p. 6).

The University of Florida's June 26, 2023 tenure-upon-hire summary states that Ana Siljak earned her PhD in History at Harvard University in 1997 and identifies Queen's University as her prior institution (p. 4).

The title page identifies After October: Russian Liberalism as a 'Work in Progress,' 1919-1945 as a Queen's University History PhD thesis dated September 2015; the acknowledgements name Ana Siljak and Rebecca Manley as the advisors (pp. i, iii).

notes: The linked record matches the institution, History department, year, and exact dissertation title stated in her CV.
